feature: Backend CCTV exact-edge route costs; existing frontend layout preserved

engineering_checks.scope: CCTV routing, vehicle access and route cache regression
CCTV routing including Depart now transport latency, fixed departure and route identity
CCTV internal client/monitor tests, operations no-CCTV regression, route requests and alternatives

proved_fixture_behavior: Busy mapped directed camera edge changes the chosen path from 240 metres to 320 metres.
The camera search penalty does not change physical ETA or emissions inputs for an unchanged path.
Stale, revoked, wrong graph, wrong direction and unmapped observations do not influence routes.
Private vehicle access remains enforced and Shortest retains its distance objective.
Live snapshots do not reuse or poison clear route cache entries.
Future departures beyond 120 seconds do not read current camera observations.
Existing Departure time control uses the current instant when its selected minute is current, preserving the original two-control layout.
Backend camera audit remains available in the route response while the current frontend renders no CCTV or surveillance text.
route_cost_formula: min(2 * edge_free_flow_s, 2 * edge_free_flow_s * vehicle_congestion_sensitivity * (camera_index / 100)^2), then weighted by route preference
binding_scope: Current graph revision; exact existing directed edge at most 750 metres long
camera_permission: Read from current trusted camera registry and aggregate-store gates on every request.
claims_not_established: Physical road speed or delay from image occupancy
live_stream_verification: Actual YOLO26s live-feed route audit and existing UI verified in backend-cctv-existing-ui.json.
final_frontend_requirement: No camera panel, camera status, upload feature or additional time controls in the app.
